title: What a signet ring is

hook.text: A signet ring was once a signature.

lines.text: A signet ring was once a signature.
Its flat face is engraved with a monogram or a crest.
Pressed into hot wax, that face leaves a mark.
The mark sealed a letter and showed who sent it.
The engraving is cut as a mirror image.
Pressed into wax, it reads the right way round.
People have worn signet rings for about 4,000 years.
lines.say: People have worn signet rings for about four thousand years.

lines.text: In ancient Egypt, a signet ring showed rank.
Today it is worn as plain jewelry.
Many have a flat face made for initials.
So a signet ring is a signature you can wear.
A render shows the face and the metal before anything is cast.

post.youtube_title: Jewelry render basics: what a signet ring is
post.caption: A signet ring has a flat face engraved with a monogram or a crest. It was pressed into hot wax to seal a letter and show who sent it, and the design is cut as a mirror image so the wax mark reads the right way round. People have worn signet rings for about 4,000 years. Today they are worn as jewelry. The renders in this video were made with HeyGema.
